name: Pressmark
tagline: Sub-25ms vector PDF synthesis for invoices, contracts, and leases
description: Generate vector PDF invoices, estimates, receipts, contracts, NDAs, and 50-state statutory real estate agreements in sub-25ms with 1-scan vector QR payment links. Exposes 6 MCP tools (`generate_document`, `preview_document`, `convert_document`, `record_payment`, `calculate_totals`, `get_pricing`). Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

install.notes: Connects over Streamable HTTP without an API key, or run locally via `pressmark --stdio`.
